rollups.text: The user collects vintage cameras. On 2023-03-14, they described owning a collection with a few rare cameras; they also own a 1950s-era Canon rangefinder that needs restoration and were excited to learn how to restore it. They were considering a UV-filtering glass-front cabinet for display.
The user collects vintage baseball cards. On 2023-03-14, they received a rare 1982 Cal Ripken Jr. baseball card in the mail.

The user has a vinyl collection. On 2023-03-14, they were organizing it and had recently acquired a rare pressing of The Cure’s “Disintegration” and a reissue of Joy Division’s “Unknown Pleasures.” They were also looking for a rare 1980 UK Factory Records pressing of Joy Division’s “Closer” (FAC 25).
The user owns a promotional copy of Radiohead’s “OK Computer” and was considering selling it to help fund vinyl collecting. On 2023-03-14, they asked how to price it.

The user collects vintage Star Wars action figures. On 2023-03-14, they had recently acquired a rare Boba Fett figure and hoped to find a mint-condition Millennium Falcon playset at a reasonable price.
The user has a cat named Luna. On 2023-03-14, they said Luna wakes them at 4:30 a.m. every day by pouncing on their chest; the user planned to try suggestions to help Luna sleep better.

The user’s lower-back pain began in mid-February 2023; they initially thought it came from lifting heavy boxes at work. On 2023-03-10, an orthopedic specialist diagnosed a herniated disk and ordered physical therapy. By 2023-03-14, the user said their doctor had directed them to take it easy for six weeks and planned to pace exercises accordingly. The user was also planning to set up a home office and consider ergonomic furniture and accessories to reduce back strain. Elapsed time: roughly three to four weeks from onset to the March 10 specialist visit, and four days from that visit to the reported plan.

On 2023-03-14, the user said they had been trying to get more into jogging and that their exercise routine had alternated between active and inactive periods, with some progress over the prior three months. They considered biking and recreational volleyball, planned to incorporate jogging and biking before adding strength training and rest days, and decided to start exercising three times per week while listening to their body. Elapsed time: the user described progress across the preceding three months; the plans and schedule were discussed on the same date.

On 2023-03-14, the user was considering a triathlon later in summer 2023. They had been swimming laps at a local pool once or twice per week and hoped to increase frequency as endurance improved; they planned to try a progressive swim plan and track progress. They also planned to start strength training twice weekly, focusing on shoulders, lats, core, and legs, beginning with lighter weights and progressing gradually. Adding yoga classes for flexibility and balance was under consideration. Elapsed time: the training plan and possible summer triathlon were discussed on the same date; the event was planned for later in 2023, with no exact date specified.

On 2023-03-14, the user said they had been feeling anxious and had never tried outdoor activities. They planned to walk outside after work that day. On 2023-03-14, they reported that the walk had taken place the previous day, 2023-03-13, and helped them feel better; they also said they were enjoying incorporating more outdoor activities into their routine. Elapsed time: one day from planned walk to reported benefit.

By 2023-03-14, they had replaced checking their phone before bed with reading, which helped them wind down, and had been going to bed around 11:30 p.m. for the preceding two weeks, except for one late movie-marathon Friday. They planned to try calming music and Headspace sleep meditations; they had downloaded Headspace weeks earlier but had not opened it. The user wakes at 6:30 a.m. daily, including weekends. Elapsed time: the bedtime pattern was reported over approximately two weeks; the app had gone unused for weeks as of March 14.

They considered waiting a few months, six months, or a year before reaching out, but also wanted to return his belongings without contacting him or trying to rekindle the relationship. They said he usually contacted them soon after breakups but had not contacted them for four days. The user also asked how to process the relationship and understand his trust issues and possessive behavior. These concerns and questions were discussed on the same date; no later outcome is recorded.
